程序包 org.bukkit.boss

接口 DragonBattle

public interface DragonBattle
代表一个末地环境中的龙战状态.

原文： Represents a dragon battle state for a world with an end environment.

  • 方法详细资料

    • getEnderDragon

      @Nullable @Nullable EnderDragon getEnderDragon()
      获取此战斗中活跃的EnderDragon.
      如果龙已被击杀则返回null.

      原文： Get the EnderDragon active in this battle.
      Will return null if the dragon has been slain.

      返回:
      末影龙. 如果已死亡则返回null

      原文：the ender dragon. null if dead

    • getBossBar

      @NotNull @NotNull BossBar getBossBar()
      获取此龙战显示的Boss血条.

      原文： Get the boss bar to be displayed for this dragon battle.

      返回:
      Boss血条

      原文：the boss bar

    • getEndPortalLocation

      @Nullable @Nullable Location getEndPortalLocation()
      获取末地传送门的位置.
      此位置将在传送门底座(底部)的中心.

      原文： Get the location of the end portal.
      This location will be at the center of the base (bottom) of the portal.

      返回:
      末地传送门的位置, 如果未生成则返回null

      原文：the end portal location or null if not generated

    • generateEndPortal

      boolean generateEndPortal(boolean withPortals)
      生成末地传送门.

      原文： Generate the end portal.

      参数:
      withPortals - 是否应生成末地传送门方块

      原文：whether end portal blocks should be generated

      返回:
      如果已生成返回true, 如果已存在返回false

      原文：true if generated, false if already present

    • hasBeenPreviouslyKilled

      boolean hasBeenPreviouslyKilled()
      检查第一只龙是否已被击杀过.

      原文： Check whether the first dragon has been killed already.

      返回:
      如果之前被击杀过返回true, 否则返回false

      原文：true if killed before, false otherwise

    • setPreviouslyKilled

      void setPreviouslyKilled(boolean previouslyKilled)
      设置第一只龙是否已被击杀过.
      如果龙之前未被击杀, 当它最终被击杀时将生成传送门.

      原文： Sets whether the first dragon has been killed already.
      If the dragon has not previously been killed, a portal will be generated when it is finally killed.

      参数:
      previouslyKilled - 如果龙之前被击杀过则为true, 否则为false

      原文：true if the dragon has been killed before, false otherwise

    • initiateRespawn

      void initiateRespawn()
      尝试启动重生序列来召唤龙, 就像玩家在传送门上放置了4个末地水晶一样.

      原文： Try to initiate a respawn sequence to summon the dragon as though a player has placed 4 end crystals on the portal.

    • initiateRespawn

      boolean initiateRespawn(@Nullable @Nullable java.util.Collection<EnderCrystal> enderCrystals)
      尝试启动重生序列来召唤龙.

      原文： Try to initiate a respawn sequence to summon the dragon.

      参数:
      enderCrystals - 用于重生的末地水晶, 为null或空列表则使重生序列不可取消. null条目或不在此龙战同一世界的水晶将被忽略.

      原文：the EnderCrystals to use in the respawn, or a null or empty list to render the respawn sequence uncancellable. null entries or crystals that do not reside in the same world as this dragon battle will be ignored.

      返回:
      如果重生已启动返回true, 否则返回false.

      原文：true if the respawn was initiated, false otherwise.

    • getRespawnPhase

      @NotNull @NotNull DragonBattle.RespawnPhase getRespawnPhase()
      获取此战斗当前的重生阶段.

      原文： Get this battle's current respawn phase.

      返回:
      当前的重生阶段.

      原文：the current respawn phase.

    • setRespawnPhase

      boolean setRespawnPhase(@NotNull @NotNull DragonBattle.RespawnPhase phase)
      设置龙的重生阶段.
      如果龙重生未在进行中, 此方法将不会成功.

      原文： Set the dragon's respawn phase.
      This method will is unsuccessful if a dragon respawn is not in progress.

      参数:
      phase - 要设置的阶段

      原文：the phase to set

      返回:
      如果成功返回true, 否则返回false

      原文：true if successful, false otherwise

      另请参阅:
      • initiateRespawn()

    • resetCrystals

      void resetCrystals()
      重置位于黑曜石柱上的水晶(移除其光束目标和无敌状态).

      原文： Reset the crystals located on the obsidian pillars (remove their beam targets and invulnerability).

    • getGatewayCount

      int getGatewayCount()
      Gets the number of gateways tracked by this DragonBattle. This starts out at 0 and will increase to 20, once for each kill of the EnderDragon.
      返回:
      the number of gateways around the end island tracked by this

    • spawnNewGateway

      boolean spawnNewGateway()
      Tries to spawn a new end gateway using default game mechanics.
      返回:
      true if successful, false if there is already the maximum.

    • spawnNewGateway

      void spawnNewGateway(@NotNull Position position)
      Spawns a new end gateway at the specified position. This will spawn regardless of the number of gateways already present.
      参数:
      position - position for the new gateway
